site.name: Anti-Corruption Center
site.tagline: Every report helps make our future cleaner

common.deleteConfirm: Delete permanently? This cannot be undone.
common.notFoundHint: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

home.heroText: Your report can be anonymous. Every report gets a unique tracking code you can use to check its status at any time.
home.step1Text: Fill in the form. You may leave your name out and submit anonymously.
home.step2Text: Keep the code - it lets you check the status of your report at any time.
home.step3Text: The report is reviewed, action is taken and an official response is written.

submit.title: Submit a report
submit.intro: Only four fields are required. The rest are optional, but they speed up the review.
submit.fieldTitleHint: Describe the situation in one sentence
submit.fieldDescriptionHint: Describe in detail what happened, who was involved and when
submit.fieldIncidentPlaceHint: For example: building 2, room 305, during the exam
submit.anonymousHint: In an anonymous report your name and phone are not stored. Only the email remains - and only to send notifications.
submit.emailHint: So we can notify you when the status changes. The report is accepted without it too.
submit.facultyHint: Leave empty if you are not sure - the report will be handled university-wide
submit.studentOnly: These fields are for students only
submit.successKeep: Keep this code. It lets you check the status of your report at any time. It cannot be recovered any other way.
submit.attachHint: Image, PDF or text file. Up to 5 files, each up to 10 MB.

track.title: Track a report
track.intro: Enter the tracking code you received when you submitted the report.
track.subject: Subject
track.noOfficial: No official response has been written yet

register.title: Public register
register.intro: This list shows every report but not its content. Title, text and official response are not displayed here - which is why the register can never expose a reporter.

staff.title: Department staff
staff.intro: Staff of the anti-corruption department and their office hours.
staff.empty: The staff list has not been filled in yet

about.empty: Information about the department has not been added yet

polls.title: Polls
polls.intro: Your opinion matters. Signing in is not required to vote.

tests.title: Tests and quizzes
tests.intro: Check your knowledge. No sign-in required to take part.
tests.done: You have already taken this test
tests.resultsHint: Results appear once you have answered
tests.randomIntro: Each participant gets {{count}} questions picked at random from {{total}}. No question appears twice.
tests.randomNote: Once you start, your questions stay the same - even if you reload the page.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: Aggregate numbers are open to everyone. They reveal no identities - only how many reports arrived and how many were resolved.
stats.ratingNote: No single score is calculated here. A high number of reports can mean two different things: the faculty has many problems, or the opposite - people trust the system and are not afraid to speak up. The one figure with an unambiguous meaning is the share of closed cases.
stats.ratingEmpty: No reports linked to a faculty yet

auth.noSelfSignUp: Accounts are created by the administrator. No account is needed to file a complaint.

my.title: My reports
my.empty: You have not submitted any reports yet
my.emptyHint: Anonymous reports do not appear in this list - they are not linked to anyone.

cabinet.overviewHint: See where your reports stand and change your account settings here.
cabinet.profileHint: Change your login (email) and password here.
cabinet.emailIsLogin: Email is currently used as the login

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.homeTextsHint: Write the home page texts for each language here. If a field is left empty, the original text is shown.
admin.homeTextsSaved: Saved. The texts on the site were updated right away.
admin.homeTextsPreview: How it looks on the site
admin.homeTextsEmptyHint: If left empty, the original text is shown
admin.homeTextsNameHint: This name also appears in the site header and footer
admin.homeTextsResetAll: Restore all texts for this language
admin.onlyAdmin: This section is for administrators only
admin.closedCanStillReply: This report is closed - its status will not change, but you can still write a response
admin.hideHint: Hide it if the details could indirectly identify the reporter
admin.anonymousInfo: Anonymous report: the reporter's name and phone were not stored. Only an email for notifications may remain.
admin.noTransitions: This report is closed - its status cannot be changed
admin.facultiesIntro: The report form is filled from this list. A faculty can only be deleted when no reports are linked to it - otherwise just deactivate it.
admin.newsLanguageHint: Each language is written as a separate article
admin.newsTranslationHint: This entry will be linked as a translation of the selected article
admin.baseLanguageHint: Base language. This text is shown wherever a translation is missing.
admin.translationFallbackHint: An empty field falls back to the base language text.
admin.biographyHint: Optional: career path, academic work, achievements
admin.slugHint: Generated from the title if left empty
admin.deleteGroupHint: Only an empty group can be deleted. Move whatever is inside to another group first.
admin.drawHint: In every test of this group each user gets {{count}} questions picked at random from the question bank. No question appears twice.
admin.drawAllHint: Tests in this group give all questions in the order they were entered.
admin.drawTestInfo: Group «{{group}}» setting: each user gets {{count}} of {{total}} questions at random.
admin.drawTestShort: Group «{{group}}» setting: {{count}} questions per user. The test has only {{total}} so far - until there are enough, users get all of them in shuffled order.
admin.groupHint: Sort them into groups - the list keeps growing year after year.
admin.correctAnswerHint: Mark at least one correct answer in every question. A single-choice question has exactly one correct answer.
admin.editOptionsWarning: Removing an existing question or option also removes its votes.
admin.draftHint: This item is a draft - it is not visible on the site yet
admin.contentHint: Use the "+" button to add a heading, text, a single image or an album. They appear on the site in the order you add them.
admin.galleryEmpty: No images added to the album yet
admin.periodHint: Leave empty to keep it open until closed manually.
admin.restartHint: “{{title}}” will be run again: a new poll is created with a copy of the questions and the current one is stopped. The previous report stays as it is and new votes are not added to it.
admin.aboutHint: There is a single such page on the site. Only filled fields are shown.
admin.aboutBodyHint: About how the department was set up and what it does. Paragraphs are kept.
admin.aboutGoalHint: Closing paragraph — the goal of the department.
admin.usersHint: Accounts are created here. There is no public sign-up.
admin.emailIsLogin: The email is also the login
admin.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. The owner can change it later.
admin.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the current password. Setting a new one signs the user out everywhere.
admin.ownPasswordHint: You change your own password on the profile page - it asks for your current password.
admin.profileHint: Change your login (email) and password here.
admin.homeTextsHowToUse: When you select a field, its place on the site is highlighted in gold in the preview. Click a text in the preview to jump to its field.
admin.bannerImagesHint: One image stays in place; several images take turns. A dark layer is laid over the image so the text stays readable. Images are saved as soon as they are uploaded, up to {{max}}.
admin.bannerImagesEmpty: No images uploaded - the banner uses the blue gradient.
admin.bannerImagesFull: The album is full ({{max}} images). Delete one to add a new image.
admin.bannerImagesDeleteHint: The image will be removed from the banner and from the server.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.fixFields: Fix the highlighted fields and submit again
